New York was never the place like -- New York was never the place like Chicago, to me.
Uh-huh, well, to you, but if -- if someone was a performer in Chicago --
-- was that the ultimate goal. Like nowadays if you want to make it, you've got to go to New York.

If you don't make it in New York, you might as well forget it. But Chicago was the place to go to get it at that time. You came to Chicago, and if -- if you came to Chicago and said you had worked in Chicago, you had been recognized in Chicago as a musician or an artist, then you were somebody.
